hero_subtitle: Amahirwe helps students in rural public schools in Rwanda find what they're good at, and connects them with mentors, teachers and real opportunities.
how_it_works_subtitle: Three simple steps, built to work even without the internet.
step_discover_body: Take a short, friendly assessment — offline or online — to find your talent area.
step_connect_body: Get matched with a verified mentor, approved by your teacher before any contact.
step_grow_body: Track your progress, earn milestones, and find scholarships and opportunities.
why_body: Many talented students in rural schools never get the chance to be noticed. Amahirwe gives every student a simple way to be seen, supported, and connected to people who can help them grow — in Kinyarwanda first.
opportunities_body: Verified mentors and opportunity providers post scholarships, competitions and internships. Every mentor match is reviewed by a teacher first, to keep students safe.
final_cta_title: Ready to discover what you're good at?
final_cta_body: It only takes a few minutes to get started — no internet required.
footer_rights: © 2026 Amahirwe. Built for students in Rwanda.
offline_message: You're offline. Your work is saved on this device and will sync when you're back online.
auth_login_subtitle: Log in to continue to your dashboard.
auth_register_subtitle: Join Amahirwe to discover your talent and find opportunities.
